0022600170.text: The Warriors, now 4-3 with a four-game winning streak and 2-1 at home, host the Suns in their eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Golden State sits second in the Pacific, one game back, and ninth in the West, while Phoenix is 1-3, has lost two straight, and is third in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and 12th in the West. Golden State trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 131-122 loss in Phoenix on October 24, 2026, though the Warriors won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery).
